body.name: Conditional-mean interior law
body.construction: An observed law is a conditional-mean interior point if, for \(P_X\)-almost every \(x\) and every retained cohort--eligibility cell \((a,s)\), the conditional mean of the finite vector \((\Delta Y_2,\ldots,\Delta Y_T)\) lies in the relative interior of the closed convex hull of its conditional essential support given \((G,S,X)=(a,s,x)\).  Relative interior is taken in the affine hull of that support, so degenerate conditional coordinates create no unattainable tangent direction.
